info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Education Enrollments Waitlists-v3-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Waitlist API provides access to information about students on waitlists for educational programs. This API allows users to retrieve a list of enrollments that are currently pending availability, assisting administrators in managing admissions effectively. Typical consumers include educational institutions and enrollment management systems that track student interest and availability. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can streamline processes and enhance communication regarding waitlist statuses.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of enrollments on the waitlist.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all enrollments that are currently placed on the waitlist, providing insights into the applicants waiting for course availability.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the waitlist for enrollments. This can be used to fetch details of enrollments that are waiting to be processed.
